description: This file defines a React functional component 'AddAgentForm' used for creating new agents via a modal form interface. It manages form state, fetches metadata, and handles form submission with different logic based on the selected agent type.

methods.name: AddAgentForm
methods.description: React functional component that renders the form inside a modal for adding new agents, with state management and side effects to fetch metadata and handle form submission.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles the form submission, constructs agent data based on selected agent type, and calls the API to create the agent.

methods.name: handleCancel
methods.description: Resets form and closes the modal without creating an agent.

methods.name: handleAgentTypeChange
methods.description: Updates the agent type state and resets the form when the user selects a different agent type.
